title: Countersignature
description: A signed, portable receipt of a decision over an Intent. counter-sign spec v0.2.

actor.description: Who decided, as channel:address — e.g. "telegram:8675309", or "default:timeout" when the Default fired.

policy.description: "approver" for an explicit human decision; "default" when the Intent's declared Default fired at the deadline.

public_key.description: base64url signing key: a raw 32-byte ed25519 key (43 chars, for a vouched/Default/raw-keyed receipt), or a passkey descriptor 'webauthn-ed25519:<43>' / 'webauthn-p256:<87>' for a WebAuthn receipt.

signature.description: base64url signature over the canonical receipt: an ed25519 signature (86 chars), OR — when 'webauthn' is present — the authenticator assertion signature (variable length, e.g. a P-256 DER ECDSA signature).

webauthn.description: Present iff this is a passkey (WebAuthn) receipt: the authenticator assertion whose challenge binds the canonical receipt digest.
